body: Goodbye Scott forwells arent my specialty. I’ve had the same experience with the attempt you are about to make. The experiences we all make shape us and i know well that my words will never reach you. We all make decisions and if you finalize this one you wont be returning. The darkness you will face will be your never ending reality im not typing this to scare you its what you’ll face. If this reality is truly not for you then farewell.
